subject: spanish

truths: “La estación de tren” means “the train station”.
“Hacer las maletas” means “to pack the suitcases”.

rounds.lie: “Quisiera reservar una habitación doble” means “I would like to cancel a single room”.
rounds.why: “Reservar” = to book and “doble” = double. “Cancel a single room” would be “cancelar una habitación individual”.
rounds.truth: “Quisiera reservar una habitación doble” means “I would like to book a double room”.
truths: “El avión lleva retraso” means “The plane is delayed”.
“¿A qué hora sale el tren?” means “What time does the train leave?”.

rounds.why: “La red” means “the net / network” (often the internet). “The screen” is “la pantalla”.

rounds.lie: “El medio ambiente” means “the middle of the room”.
rounds.why: “El medio ambiente” is a set phrase meaning “the environment”, not anything to do with a room.

rounds.lie: “Vivo en las afueras” means “I live in the city centre”.
rounds.why: “Las afueras” means the outskirts/suburbs. “City centre” is “el centro (de la ciudad)”.
rounds.truth: “Vivo en las afueras” means “I live on the outskirts”.
truths: “Mi barrio es tranquilo” means “My neighbourhood is quiet”.
“Hay mucha contaminación” means “There is a lot of pollution”.

rounds.why: False friend — “actualmente” means “currently / nowadays”. “Actually” is “en realidad / de hecho”.
truths: “Conectarse a internet” means “to connect to the internet”.

rounds.why: “Deberíamos” is the conditional = “we should”. “We recycled” would be “reciclamos” (past tense).
rounds.truth: “Deberíamos reciclar más” means “We should recycle more”.
